metadataRaw.title: How to Quickly Lubricate Stiff Hips
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over easy exercises to lubricate and loosen stiff hips.

If you feel like your hips are locked-up and don't want to move, definitely check these exercises out. 

They're going to help increase blood flood (and circulation) to break up tightness around the hips, and are relieving issues such as minor stiffness to hip osteoarthritis (wear and tear arthritis). 

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives the most relief.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:29 Trifecta Stretch
3:44 Wall Sits
5:22 Hip Flexors and Glutes
8:50 Rotation Stretch
10:37 Clamshells and Scissors
